subtitle: A 7-mile Welsh beach where five land-speed record attempts were made between 1924 and 1927, now a fenced Ministry of Defence range for most of the working week.
spike_statement: Parry-Thomas died chasing the land speed record here in 1927; his car Babs was mutilated on inquest orders, buried in the dunes, then exhumed and restored.

levers.photo_tone: Flat gray-gold sand under low Welsh light, a vintage racer's silhouette against military warning signage
